reader.requirement: No line of a page heading report group may be presented on or past FIRST DETAIL integer-3 (last permitted line integer-3 - 1), for both Table 2 rows (A R; R placed from HEADING or after the report heading's final LINE-COUNTER); since 1985 placements are fixed by the description, the compiler must refuse a description whose page heading reaches integer-3 and present one ending on integer-3 - 1. (The rule's text is the transcription's reconstruction of missing folios XIII-30/31, matching §1985:XIII.3.8.3 SR8b.)

year<2002 page heading: limit FIRST DETAIL - 1 with §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR1c words; later the same limit with 2023 words

reader.notes: All forms are refused at compile time once a page heading line reaches FIRST DETAIL, and legal headings ending on FIRST DETAIL - 1 print there. The rule's own text is reconstructed (kb/Work PB4952); the printed SR8b states the same subdivision. Absolute and A R refusals cite §2023 rules at --std 85 (wording only).

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:XIII.3.10.7 (reconstructed folios; its GR2 lower limit integer-3 - 1 agrees with the printed §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR1c and the Table 1 page regions of §1985:XIII.3.8.5), §1985:XIII.3.10.6 GR4/GR5 (report heading NEXT GROUP) and §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR2b (FIRST DETAIL implied = integer-2), and GroupLimits/Cobol85FinalLineCounter/RelativeGroupLowerLimit. Probes at --std 85: p2a (PAGE LIMIT 12 only: integer-2 = integer-3 = 1, PH LINE 1) -> COBOL2199 below the lower limit 0; p2b (same, PH LINE PLUS 1 -> line 1) -> COBOL2199 reach line 1, past line 0; p2c (RH LINE 2 NEXT GROUP 3, absolute, final LINE-COUNTER 3; PH LINE PLUS 1 -> 4 = FIRST DETAIL) -> COBOL2199 placed after the report heading's final LINE-COUNTER setting 3, past line 3; p2d (RH NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE, PH LINE PLUS 3 from HEADING 2 -> 4) -> COBOL2199 reach line 4, past line 3 (the NEXT PAGE report heading correctly seeds nothing); p2e (same, PH LINE PLUS 2) -> runs; bytes CRLF 'RH' FF CRLF CRLF 'PH' CRLF 'DE': RH alone on page 1 line 2, PH on page 2 line 3 = integer-3 - 1, DE on line 4. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.10.7 GR2  (3.10.7 Page Heading Group Presentation Rules)  the text is in GR2 [RECONSTRUCTED: editorial text, not the standard's; kb/Work PB4952]'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR2b  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR2b'.
